title: What If You Never Cut Your Hair? It Stops on Its Own
subject: hair growth

scenes.text: What if you never cut your hair? It would stop growing on its own.
Scalp hair grows roughly one centimeter every 28 days, about an inch every 71 days.
But each strand has a growth phase of just two to seven years.
Then it rests, falls out, and a new hair starts in its place.
About 85 to 90 percent of your scalp hairs are growing right now.
On arms and legs the growth phase is only 30 to 45 days, so those hairs stay short.
